# Rich Response

Mengubah markdown menjadi interactive AI-style message WhatsApp.

## Cara Pakai

Cukup tambah `rich: true` di `sendMessage`:

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  text: `
# Judul

Text biasa dengan *bold* _italic_ ~strikethrough~

Kode:
\`\`\`javascript
const greet = (name) => {
  return "Hello " + name
}
console.log(greet("World"))
\`\`\`

Tabel:
| Nama | Umur | Kota |
|------|------|------|
| Ana  | 25   | JKT  |

![gambar](https://example.com/foto.jpg)
  `,
  rich: true,
})
```

## Support Markdown

| Fitur | Sintaks | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| Heading 1-4 | `# text` `## text` | `# Judul` |
| Bold | `*text*` | `*bold*` |
| Italic | `_text_` | `_italic_` |
| Strikethrough | `~text~` | `~coret~` |
| Monospace | `` `text` `` | `` `code` `` |
| List | `- item` | `- List item` |
| Link | `[text](url)` | `[GitHub](https://github.com)` |
| Horizontal rule | `---` | Terserah |
| Blockquote | `> text` | `> Kutipan` |
| Code block | ` ```lang` | ` ```javascript` |
| Table | `\| A \| B \|` | Pipe delimiter |
| Image | `![alt](url)` | `![foto](url)` |
| Suggest | `:::suggest` | Tombol saran |

## Contoh Lengkap

### Dengan Title & Footer

```ts
const msg = buildRichResponseMessage(
  '*Halo!* Ada yang bisa dibantu?\n\n:::suggest\nPromo | Bantuan\n:::',
  { title: 'Mataram Bot', footer: 'Ketik /help untuk bantuan' }
)
```

### Link (Inline Entity)

```ts
const msg = buildRichResponseMessage(
  'Kunjungi [website kami](https://example.com) untuk info lebih lanjut'
)
```

### Mixed Content

```ts
const msg = buildRichResponseMessage(`
# Laporan Penjualan

Berikut data bulan ini:

| Bulan | Total | Target |
|-------|-------|--------|
| Jan   | 50jt  | 45jt   |
| Feb   | 55jt  | 45jt   |

\`\`\`python
total = 50000000 + 55000000
rata2 = total / 2
print(f"Average: {rata2}")
\`\`\`

![chart](https://example.com/chart.png)

Detail: [lihat laporan lengkap](https://example.com/laporan)

:::suggest
Download PDF | Cetak
:::
`, { title: 'Laporan Bulanan' })
```
